summary_bullets: Prevent /upgrade-larch from deleting the running cached version mid-upgrade
Stamp every successful install so unstamped dirs no longer rank below all stamped versions
Backfill mtime-derived install stamps at prune entry for legacy unstamped cache dirs
Align upgrade-larch, SECURITY, and installation docs with the new stamp and retention contract
commit_message:
Fix /upgrade-larch pruning the currently-running version

Retain both the prune target and INSTALLED_VERSION during cache prune, write install stamps on any successful install (prune still gated on verified stable), and backfill persistent mtime-derived stamps for unstamped cache dirs at prune entry. Sync upgrade-larch.md, SECURITY.md, and docs/installation-and-setup.md.
